detail.longDescription: Muse got caught telling a user, point-blank, that it couldn't see his Messages. It could, it had synced the whole local database. Days later Amazon locked it out of its own store over the same worry: that Muse doesn't tell the truth about what it's grabbing. https:// blog.ppb1701.com/muse-already- lied-about-what-it-reads-guess-why-amazon-doesnt-trust-it-either # bigtech # amazon # meta # ai # aiagents # privacy # dataprivacy # userhostile # antitrust # blog
